primary_root_cause: Charging system output failure (voltage regulator or stator)
other_likely_causes: Loose, corroded, or high-resistance battery, ground, or charging connections
recommended_first_check: Measure voltage directly across the battery terminals at idle and again above 2000 RPM with a digital multimeter; it should rise when engine speed increases.
reasoning: P0562 sets when the ECM sees battery voltage below 12.2 V at idle and no voltage increase above 2000 RPM, which most strongly indicates the battery is not being charged while the engine runs. Confirming battery-terminal voltage first separates a charging-output fault from a failed battery or resistance in the battery and ground connections.
